explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 60 configurations over 14 sweeps (topology, ep-off, pipeline, moe-collective, kv-capacity, batch-caps, routing-prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, pd-ratio, pd-always, pd-wide-decode, pd-pool-engine, pd-decode-cudagraph, cudagraph), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.

No configuration that was run held the scenario's SLOs at any tested load, so the 236 runs that were made bound the deployment from below rather than recommending one. 4 further runs were refused and are not evidence of a miss.
